description: AutoNumber reseed: Au1 (ten rows) receives ALTER TABLE Au1 ALTER COLUMN ID COUNTER(200, 5); then an insert without an ID, whose ID is read by @@IDENTITY. The ALTER may be refused (the key column is the primary key); the refusal is an observation. Asks what the file shows after each step and which ID the insert gets. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
